sloka: मुक्ताभिः च प्रवालैः च रूप्य चामी करैर् अपि ।विभूषिताम् मणि स्तम्भैः सुबहु स्तम्भ भूषिताम् ॥५-९-२४॥
transliteration: muktābhiḥ ca pravālaiḥ ca rūpya cāmī karair api ।vibhūṣitām maṇi stambhaiḥ subahu stambha bhūṣitām ॥5-9-24॥

translations.english: It was decorated with pillars of silver and gold inlaid with pearls and corals and gems.
